description: Verify that the applied.diff file contains exactly one hunk header (e.g., @@ ... @@).
Ensure the diff does not contain any lines starting with '+++' or '--+' that indicate a second hunk or file header beyond the first.
Confirm that the diff contains at least one added line starting with '+' and at least one removed line starting with '-' (excluding the header lines).
Validate that the diff is a valid unified diff format by checking for the presence of a file header (--- or +++) at the beginning.
